item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q015_artifact_tag_not_homology","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, d1a14h2 (1a14 H:1–8; sunid 343393) is a synthetic N-terminal tag, classified as l.1.1.1: family “Tags,” superfamily “Tags” (l.1.1), fold “Tags” (l.1), and class “Artifacts” (l). These are artifact bookkeeping categories, not assertions of evolutionary homology. Similarity confined to this eight-residue tag should not be treated as evidence that the attached proteins are homologous, nor used to transfer function or select a native-domain structural template. Mask or exclude the tag in such comparisons. The separate segment d1a14h1 (H:9–111; sunid 20061) is classified as b.1.1.1, the immunoglobulin V-set family; any homology inference must be supported by similarity across the biological domain, independently of the tag.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1a14h2","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1a14h1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/343393","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/20061","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/311501","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310894","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310682","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310607","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310573","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310555"]}]}
